name: qa-reqres-api-testing-portfolio
description: API testing portfolio for Reqres using Postman, Newman, GitHub Actions, and HTML reporting.

scripts.test:api:smoke: newman run postman/reqres-api-collection.json -e postman/reqres-environment.json --folder "01 - Smoke Tests" --delay-request 1000 --timeout-request 20000 --reporters cli,json,junit,htmlextra --reporter-json-export evidence/reports/reqres-api-testing-portfolio/newman/smoke-results.json --reporter-junit-export evidence/reports/reqres-api-testing-portfolio/newman/smoke-results.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export evidence/reports/reqres-api-testing-portfolio/html/smoke-report.html
